## 1. BAR rule (vsess_50, run-merged _CANC)
Code for the kernel: `outputs/code/th_bars/kernels.py` k_cum lines 10-31 (mode 0, metric = size); thresholds `outputs/code/th_bars/build_month.py` scales() lines 13-32 and line 96 (`np.maximum(svol/p,1.0)`, p = 50); session split `outputs/code/th_bars/common.py` lines 10-17 (ET: code 0 Asia 18:00-02:00, 1 London 02:00-08:30, 2 pre 08:30-09:30, 3 NY AM 09:30-12:00, 4 NY PM 12:00-16:00, 5 close 16:00-18:00; td = ET + 6 h; session id td x 10 + code).
1. PRINT STREAM = run-merged prints (D8_PRINT_RULE.md section 1 and 4, `_CANC`): side of a record = BUY if last >= ask, else SELL if last <= bid, else 0 (buy test first); consecutive records with the same price AND the same side form ONE print (volume summed, no time condition; never across a session boundary or contract change). The merged print is stamped with the time the run is KNOWN complete = the timestamp of the next print with a different price or side (a session's last run: its own last record). Verified on td 20261110 NY AM: 208,040 prints, 100.000% identical boundaries versus the NT8 export (D8_PRINT_RULE.md section 4 table); the builder script was not found by me (open point a).
2. BAR KERNEL k_cum: bars are per session key (td x 10 + code) and instrument id; at a change of key or instrument the open bar is emitted as part = 1 (known at its last print) and the series restarts at bar index 0. A bar opens at the first print after the previous bar closed (or at the session's first print); each print is added WHOLE to the open bar (volume += print size, high/low/close updated); then `cum >= thr` (greater-or-equal, kernels.py line 28) closes the bar with this print: the closing print STAYS in the closing bar (no split, no carry), cum resets to 0 at the next bar. Known time = timestamp (stamp) of the closing print.
3. THRESHOLD thr = max(sess_vol[3] / 50, 1.0) contracts (float) for every print of NY AM of that td, fixed for the whole session. sess_vol[code][td] = median of the previous up to 20 values of that session code's session volume in the stats table (the 20 ROWS before the td in stats_day order, not calendar days; the current session is not used; values <= 0 or missing dropped; at least 5 needed, else back/forward fill) (build_month.py lines 23-31). Session volume = sum of `sz` of EVERY trade record of that session code of the td, all instrument ids (th_bars/stats.py, as in D8_ASIA_NEWBOOK_INPUTS.md section 1).
4. Thresholds the engine used (A = engine store as it is, the stored bars_c; reproduced with scales()): td 20261027: code 0 1,245.99 / 1 1,265.03 / 2 426.60 / **3 4,872.64** / 4 3,744.58 / 5 310.92; td 20261110: 0 1,704.24 / 1 1,394.68 / 2 493.66 / **3 5,265.95** / 4 4,255.57 / 5 369.39 (medians 243,632 and 263,297.5 contracts for code 3). All six codes are given because the trigger runs on the continuous series of ALL sessions (section 2). Stored-bar check, NY AM: td 20261027 47 closed bars of 4,873-4,911 contracts + 1 truncated bar of 803 = 229,938 = the session total in hist_replica; td 20261110 55 closed bars of 5,266-5,302 + 1 truncated of 2,995 = 292,676 = session total. Overshoot above thr (0.05 to 38.4 contracts) is the merged print that closes the bar.
5. FIRST BAR starts at the first print (run) of the session; its t0 in the store is the stamp of that first merged print (13:30:00.001Z on 20261027, 14:30:00.000Z on 20261110), the same stamp rule as section 1. The last bar of the session is the truncated bar with part = 1 (known at the last print of the session): it is never a signal bar.
6. Bars per NY AM session: 48 on 20261027 and 56 on 20261110 (47 / 55 full bars + the truncated one). The count varies with the day's volume against the median.

## 2. TRIGGER rule (every constant)
Code: `outputs/code/th_grid/trig_trend_ma_ema.py` lines 18-28, `outputs/code/th_grid/trend_common.py` (leff, ma, hold, frame_flips), `outputs/code/th_grid/ind.py` ema lines 6-12. Variant `cross` (plain, not native), len = 20, width = 2, hyst = 0.0. Input line: bar CLOSE in points of the book's own vsess_50 bars.
1. The bar series is ONE continuous series of ALL sessions (Asia, London, pre, NY AM, NY PM, close; each bar with its own session's threshold; part = 1 bars included) in known-time order, from 2023-04-02 (D8_BAR_DEFS.md section 2). So the EMA state runs across session and weekend breaks.
2. fast = EMA(close, 20), slow = EMA(close, min(round(20 x 2), 300)) = EMA(close, 40). EMA recursion: alpha = 2/(n+1) (0.095238 and 0.048780); value_0 = close_0 (first bar of the series), value_j = alpha x close_j + (1 - alpha) x value_{j-1} (ind.py lines 6-12; no SMA seed).
3. Hysteresis band a = 0 (plain variant: h = 0.0, trig_trend_ma_ema.py line 25; the `hyst` param in the dict is not used by `cross`, and `width` = 2 is the slow/fast LENGTH RATIO, not a band). State: +1 if fast > slow (strict), -1 if fast < slow (strict), otherwise the previous state is held (`hold`, trend_common.py).
4. EVENT = a true flip: LONG at bar j when state_j = +1 and state_{j-1} = -1 (previous state must be exactly -1: a transition from state 0 at the start of the series is not an event); SHORT when state_j = -1 and state_{j-1} = +1 (`frame_flips`). Computed at the bar close (known time). Both sides are traded.
5. Warm-up for a coder: the engine EMAs have infinite memory from 2023-04-02; with a fresh start the EMAs must be seeded. Exact method: take the ema20/ema40 values printed in the first INPUTS row of each day as the state and continue. Tested numerically: seeding 100, 200, 300, 500, 1000 or 2000 bars before the evaluated window (first close as seed) reproduced every flip of the last 20,000 bars of history in all tested chunks; recommended seed >= 300 bars of the all-session series (about 6 sessions), a test, not a proof.
6. The first NY AM bars can flip against the state carried from the pre-market (e.g. 20261110: the first NY AM bar flips short).

## 3. From signal to order (events pipeline)
Same engine path as the other books (`outputs/code/th_brkt/brkt_build.py` lines 34-48 and, for the CANC events, `th_d8spec/bulk_fl.py` + `th_nyeng/ny_build.events`): keep a flip only if the signal bar has part == 0 and session code == 3; order time ts = floor(known time to whole seconds) + 2 s; exit_ts = 12:00 ET; drop ts >= exit_ts; BOTH sides kept (cell mode both); stop 80.0 / target 40.0 (SHAPES F80_40, brkt_build.py line 19); lots 1; cap_exit.cap_events. Verified: independent pipeline on the stored bars_c gives 1,286 events identical in time and side to the stored file, which equals `_d8spec/ev/L39287638_CANC.parquet` in ts, side and exit_ts.

## 4. SIDES, BRACKET, UNITS
BOTH sides (long = buy on a bullish flip, short = sell on a bearish flip). STOP 80 points and TARGET 40 points from the fill, NQ POINTS (4 ticks of 0.25 = $20 per contract: stop 320 ticks = $1,600, target 160 ticks = $800). Fixed, no unit rule (the cell's plain60/60 is NOT used). Verified in the events file (all 1,286) and the 20261027 trades (targets +40.00 exactly, long and short).

## 5. OTHER-MARKET OR LEVEL INPUTS
None. Only the book's own vsess_50 closes. The only other inputs are the per-session volume medians of section 1 (stats table of NQ session volumes).

## 6. ONE-POSITION RULE, SESSION WINDOW
One position per book (D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2)): an event while in a trade / exit pending / entry in flight is dropped. Signals only from NY AM bars (09:30-12:00 ET) with part == 0; flat at 12:00 ET. Because a flip needs a state change, events alternate in side within the series; on 20261027 three events (long 13:34:54Z, short 14:05:17Z, long 14:34:32Z) all became trades, each exited at its target before the next order.

## 7. Entry, fill and exit mechanics (quoted, not re-derived)
As in D8_BUILD_SPEC.md (b2): market order at ts, filled 1.0 s later walking the 10-level book, stop at fill -/+ 80, target limit at fill +/- 40, flat at 12:00 ET + 1.0 s. Check on 20261027: entry times = order times + 1.000 s (13:34:55, 14:05:18, 14:34:33), targets filled at exactly entry +/- 40.00.

## 8. Parity data, td 20261027 (EDT, NY AM 13:30-16:00Z) and td 20261110 (EST, NY AM 14:30-17:00Z)
BARS = NY AM bars of `/mnt/l2/l2vast/_d8spec/bars_c/vsess_50/202610.parquet` and `202611.parquet` (volume = contracts of merged prints; known time = stamp of the closing merged print; the last row part = 1). SIGNALS = the stored events rows of that td. INPUTS = the 60 bars before the NY AM open (all sessions) and all NY AM bars, with ema20, ema40, state, and the flips (full precision, usable as seed). TRADES = engine exact-set bare 1-lot trades.

## Relay questions 2026-11-24 21:25Z (answers added by W-NYAMSPEC2; engine files untouched)
Q4a. THE EMAs DO NOT RESTART PER SESSION. This is almost certainly why 2 of 3 signals are one bar off for you. The engine EMA20 and EMA40 run over ONE continuous series of all vsess_50 bars of all session codes (0..5) in known-time order since 2023-04-02, never reset at a session, day or weekend break, including part = 1 bars (the last bar of every session) as ordinary bars (trig_trend_ma_ema.py lines 24-28; ind.py ema lines 6-12).
Q4b. Init: first value = the first close of the series (2023-04-02 evening); thereafter ema_j = a x close_j + (1 - a) x ema_{j-1}, a = 2/21 for EMA20 and 2/41 for EMA40; no SMA seed. width = 2 is the slow/fast LENGTH RATIO (slow length = min(round(20 x 2), 300) = 40), NOT a band; hysteresis = 0 for this plain variant (the hyst key is ignored; the comparison is strict fast > slow = state +1, fast < slow = state -1, equal holds the old state). Event = flip of state (previous state exactly the opposite); computed at the bar close.
Q4c. To reproduce without the 2023 history: seed ema20 and ema40 with the full-precision values in the first row of the INPUTS block of each day (8.1/8.2) and continue bar by bar through all sessions; or start >= 300 bars earlier on the all-session series (section 2 item 5). A per-session restart changes the EMA values at the NY AM open and moves crossovers by a bar or more.
Q4d. The bars of ALL sessions are needed for the series, each built with its own session's threshold = max(median20 of that code / 50, 1). TRAILING-20 MEDIAN TABLES, every session code, 45 trading dates (20260922 to 20261123), layout as D8_ASIA_NEWBOOK_INPUTS.md section 1b. Code c0 = Asia, c1 = London, c2 = pre 08:30-09:30, c3 = NY AM, c4 = NY PM, c5 = close 16:00-18:00 (ET). Rule (th_bars/build_month.py lines 23-31 and 96): median of the previous up to 20 stats_day ROWS of that code's session volume (values <= 0 or missing dropped, >= 5 needed), thr = max(median/50, 1.0) contracts, fixed for the whole session of the td.
TABLE A = AS STORED: the engine store as it is (holes: no row for 20261102-04; 20261105 is a half day in the store; store ends 20261113; blank = the engine has no row, never ran). Reproduces the stored bars (spot check: 20261027 and 20261110 equal the thresholds above for all six codes).
